The school-setting and food-consumption blocks were tested but left out: each reduced retrieval substantially, yet only 12 known eligible records were available, below the skill’s 15-record threshold for requiring either optional block. The resulting 70,390 records exceed the 10,000-record workload budget, an accepted risk in favor of broad retrieval.

The strategy retrieved 12/12 known development records. That is **100% relative recall in a small development set**, not an estimate of sensitivity; there was no independent validation set. The internal critic passed all six domains, but this draft still needs **PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use**.
